payload.label: Check my app's bundle only uses what each package made public
payload.job: Stop a build that takes a file from a package that did not declare it public: read the bundler's own list of what went into the finished bundle and report every import that reaches into a package's private files
payload.description: Give metafile_file (the bundler's metafile, esbuild's shape, a path inside the folder the person granted for reading), packages_root (the folder whose sub-folders are packages), declaration (how a package declares its public files: file, the name of the declaration file in each package folder; entries_at, the dotted path to the list in it; kind_at and kind, where each entry says what it is and the value that means public source; path_at, where it names the file or folder) and optionally bundle_root (what the metafile's relative paths are relative to; the granted folder when absent). The tool has no default declaration. Each import from outside a package to a file the package did not declare, and each use of a package whose declaration file cannot be read, is a finding in words. Imports inside one package, to files no package owns, to external modules and to virtual modules are not judged. Returns ok, edges_checked, packages_reached and findings.

metafile_file.description: A path inside the granted folder to the bundler's metafile (JSON)

packages_root.description: A path inside the granted folder to the folder whose sub-folders are packages

bundle_root.description: A path inside the granted folder that the metafile's relative paths are relative to

file.description: The declaration file's name inside each package folder

entries_at.description: Dotted path to the list of entries in it

kind_at.description: Dotted path, inside an entry, to what the entry is

kind.description: The value at kind_at that means the entry declares a public file or folder

path_at.description: Dotted path, inside an entry, to the public file or folder, relative to the package
